description: This file defines the SparkDefaultUDAFEvaluatorResolver class, which provides an implementation for resolving UDAF evaluators in Hive, specifically avoiding calls to FunctionRegistry to prevent initializing Hive built-in UDFs. It includes methods for extracting the UDAF class, locating evaluator classes, and matching methods based on argument types.

classes.name: SparkDefaultUDAFEvaluatorResolver
classes.description: Implements UDAFEvaluatorResolver to resolve UDAF evaluators in Hive, based on UDAF class and method reflection, avoiding initialization of Hive built-in UDFs.

methods.name: SparkDefaultUDAFEvaluatorResolver
methods.description: Constructor that extracts the UDAF class from a wrapped DefaultUDAFEvaluatorResolver instance.

methods.name: getEvaluatorClass
methods.description: Returns the evaluator class for the UDAF based on argument types by inspecting nested classes and methods.
